name: DownBars
description: Represents the down bars in a chart group.
remarks: Down bars connect points on the first series in the chart group with lower values on the last series (the lines go down from the first series). Only 2D line groups that contain at least two series can have down bars. This object isn't a collection. There's no object that represents a single down bar; you either have up bars and down bars turned on for all points in a chart group or you have them turned off. If the HasUpDownBars property of the ChartGroup object is False, most properties of the DownBars object are disabled.
example:
With Worksheets("sheet5").ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartGroups(1)
 .HasUpDownBars = True
 .UpBars.Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
 .DownBars.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
End With
